summary: LLM7 documents a free dashboard token with text-generation limits of 1 request per second, 60 per minute, 250 per hour, and 100,000 tokens per 24 hours. Its current limits page no longer documents anonymous access.
claim_steps: Obtain a free token from the LLM7 dashboard at dash.llm7.io.
Send an OpenAI-compatible request with that token and a currently available model.
Stay within the free-token limits of 60 requests per minute, 250 per hour, and 100,000 tokens per 24 hours.

social_proof.title: Limits - LLM7.io Documentation
social_proof.text: Free token: 1 req/sec, 60 req/min, 250 req/hour, 100,000 tokens per 24 hours. Obtain a free token from dash.llm7.io.
